cases.stderr:
✗ invalid --device argument: the option and its value arrived as one argument                                                                              
Store only the device selector in DEVICE and pass it separately, for example:                                                                              
  wendy --device "$DEVICE" device ros2 topics                                                                                                              
In zsh, use an argument array if you need to store both the option and value. This is a command syntax error; retrying the unchanged command will not help.
